reference_findings.diagnosis: Symptomatic severe calcified LAD disease; lesion preparation and revascularization planning require expert review, especially given CKD and vascular comorbidity.
reference_findings.risk_assessment: High anatomical complexity; qualitative simulation label only, not a validated score.

investigation_reports.laboratory_panel: No acute hs-cTn delta; creatinine 1.6 mg/dL and eGFR 41 mL/min/1.73 m2 in synthetic report; Hb 11.8 g/dL; potassium 4.4 mmol/L.
investigation_reports.coronary_or_other_imaging: Reference angiography: 85% heavily calcified proximal-to-mid LAD lesion with moderate tortuosity; TIMI 3 flow; LCx 40%, RCA 50%. Angiographic calcium description is qualitative; intravascular imaging result is not yet supplied.
investigation_reports.initial_vitals: HR 80 bpm; BP 138/82 mmHg; RR 17/min; SpO2 97%; stable.
investigation_reports.not_supplied: Any test not explicitly listed is not ordered/not available; it must not be interpreted as normal.

history.chief_complaint: Progressive exertional angina and reduced activity over two months.
history.history_of_present_illness: Stable at rest in the scenario; symptoms limit ordinary activity.
medication_reconciliation: Medication list and adherence review pending
allergy_history: Contrast history unknown; must be verified

differential_diagnosis: Microvascular disease coexisting with epicardial CAD
Heart failure contribution to exercise limitation

pathway_review.label: Specialist review of lesion morphology and whether intravascular imaging is useful
pathway_review.reason: Calcification can affect lesion assessment and intervention planning.

pathway_review.label: Assume routine lesion treatment is appropriate without assessing calcium/anatomy
pathway_review.reason: Ignores lesion complexity and potential procedural risk.

pathway_review.label: Explicitly review renal function and contrast-sparing planning as appropriate
pathway_review.reason: CKD is a relevant safety and planning variable.

reference_findings.safety_review: Renal function, contrast exposure, anemia, vascular access considerations, bleeding risk, allergy history and informed consent are mandatory simulation checklist fields.
reference_findings.simulated_clinical_course: Reference branch: intravascular imaging clarifies calcium distribution in a synthetic report; learner chooses among reviewed planning options and receives a complication-risk debrief.
learning_objectives: Include CKD and anemia in safety planning.
Do not present device selection/settings as universal instructions.
reference_findings.review_note: Synthetic scenario. Clinical values and pathway labels require qualified interventional cardiology review before deployment. Educational use only; not real-patient guidance.
